blocks.body:
## Executive Summary

Coach House has built a meaningful external lead base, but its active and paying core is much smaller. The strongest signal comes from nonprofit builders and organization owners. A sustained May acquisition wave created most accounts, while missing first-touch tracking prevents reliable campaign attribution.

## Who the audience appears to be

The strongest customer profile is a nonprofit builder or organization leader. Email domains suggest a mix of formally affiliated organization leaders and grassroots founders using personal accounts. Selected focus is self-reported intent, not a verified job title.

Forty-six percent use an organization or custom email domain, 37% use Gmail, and 18% use another consumer provider. The 82 custom-domain accounts span 73 domains, indicating a broad set of mostly separate organizations.

## When they arrived

The account base did not grow evenly. Most registrations came through one sustained wave across May rather than one bulk-import timestamp.

The May cohort contains 110 accounts. Only 25 have a recorded authenticated session and 15 produced any tracked product activity, which explains much of the gap between registrations and active users.

## Organization maturity and geography

Organization records show both established nonprofits and earlier-stage projects. Geographic coverage is too sparse for a platform-wide claim.
Only 17 of 53 organizations supplied a usable state, and all 17 are in Illinois. Treat Illinois as a strong signal among known records, not proof that the entire audience is Illinois-based.

## Current traffic context

From July 4 through August 3, Vercel recorded 184 anonymous visitors, 990 page views, and a 43% bounce rate. Traffic was 97% United States and 86% desktop. Anonymous visitors cannot be matched one-to-one with the 180 accounts.

## What is still unknown

Historical signup records did not preserve first-touch source, UTM campaign values, initial referrer, landing page, or partner code. The May pattern is consistent with a sustained campaign, launch, or community push, but the responsible source cannot be verified from current data.

## Recommended next steps

1. Treat Build-focused founders and organization owners as the primary customer profile.
2. Reactivate the May cohort, especially accounts with no authenticated session recorded.
3. Rework the Find signup and onboarding path before spending to grow it.
4. Store first-touch attribution and partner codes at signup before the next campaign.
5. Report registrations, recorded authentication, tracked active users, and payers as separate measures.

## Definitions and limits

The 180 figure counts accounts, not deduplicated humans or customers. `last_sign_in_at` means Supabase recorded at least one authenticated session, possibly during signup or email confirmation; it does not prove a later manual login or current activity. Product activity requires a tracked event. Stripe is authoritative for payment status. Marketing and newsletter flags were excluded because historical defaults make them unreliable preference evidence.
